name: cadenway-design-system
description: cadenway-design-system tooling: 12 cw-ds-* agents (component, story, theme, icon, test and release builders plus read-only accessibility, motion, design, package and architecture reviewers for the Angular design system, plus a .github maintainer), 13 /cw-* commands, 9 path-scoped rules, 12 skills, and the guard, git-guard and format hooks. The plugin root is this .claude/ folder; the hooks only act inside a cadenway-design-system checkout.
